title: Possible to change the limit of a refinementList widget real time ?
body:
lets say i limit my brands to 5 values at a start .
then lets say i want to be able to change this limit to 10.
right now i added a show more link in the template footer, and i was hoping to change the limit of the widget and call a render or search event or something.

any idea on how to do that please ?
